cohort: 16,775 women who gave birth between January 2016 and December 2017
finding: Obstetric interventions and complications, including emergency cesareans section and postpartum hemorrhage, were significantly related to dissatisfaction with childbirth.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was a main risk factor for dissatisfaction with childbirth (aOR 3.98 95% CI 3.27-4.86).
